pages.text: The Integrated Block recombines ingredients placed in fixed slots. Each recipe requires a minimum frame tier, shown with the recipe display.$(br2)Nearby valid materials are collected automatically. A redstone signal stops this collection without disabling the crafting process.

pages.title: Tier 1 Frame
pages.text: The first frame extends the range of recipes the block can perform.

pages.title: Tier 2 Frame
pages.text: The second frame supports more complex combinations.

pages.title: Tier 3 Frame
pages.text: The third frame is the current highest tier.

pages.title: Beacon Assistance
pages.text: A Beacon positioned two blocks below the Integrated Block causes each completed recipe to produce a second copy.$(br)This works with every frame tier.
